contentText: US President Donald Trump is expected to ⁠push for progress in the stalled ceasefire in Gaza when he meets with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu for talks on December 29 that will include Israel's concerns over Hezbollah in Lebanon and Iran. For Netanyahu, the meeting comes amid domestic dissatisfaction over his management of the situation. FRANCE 24's Noga Tarnopolsky tells us what's at stake for the Israeli PM straight from Jerusalem.
